## Plugin reference

- Description: The menu-bar panel's Wish section (MenuBar.Section 'wish'): wish's WishField under a 'Wish' title — the task composer with its own ↑, filing one task under Wishes and confirming inline. The tray is about no page (DraftPage NO_DRAFT_PAGE: no Page URL toggle, no element picker). The field keeps its own draft text.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `MenuBar.Section` "Wish" → `MenuBarWishSection`
  - Uses:
    - `companions/menu-bar.MenuBar`
    - `companions/panel.PanelSection`
    - `tasks/task-draft-form.DraftPageProvider`
    - `tasks/task-draft-form.NO_DRAFT_PAGE`
    - `wish.WishField`
